=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url (lines 3040-3052) and _resolve_origin_url (lines 3077-3083) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GitHub tokens are embedded directly into HTTPS clone URLs instead of being supplied through per-process http.extraHeader authentication.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, Git diagnostics, and recorded URLs, reversing the prior credential-isolation contract.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 578-585) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick remote URLs embed GH_PAT or GH_TOKEN in the URL passed to clone and push subprocesses.
  WHY: The token can leak through process inspection, Git diagnostics, and tooling that records subprocess arguments.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The diagnose Codex invocation bypasses the model-provider broker and runs with `--sandbox danger-full-access` while GH_TOKEN and OPENROUTER_API_KEY remain available.
  WHY: Issue-derived or captured diagnostic text can cause the model to read or exfiltrate credentials and mutate the workspace; all reviewers classify this as critical/blocker.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 240-247 (normalize_path) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The sensitive-path filter was removed, allowing caller-supplied paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, `.ssh`, and `.aws` to be read into model prompts.
  WHY: Repo-root containment does not prevent sensitive files from being resolved and inlined, exposing credentials and Git metadata.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 140-518 (entire broker-lifecycle block removed) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model_provider_broker lifecycle and execution functions were deleted while live workflow and script callers still invoke them.
  WHY: Model-call phases fail with command-not-found before Codex starts, and the broker's credential-isolation boundary is absent.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 137-187, 594-611, 624-628, 767-768, 883-884, 919-920 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `_memory_git` per-process authentication wrapper was deleted and memory operations now call bare git.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, memory branch checks, clones, and pushes fail authentication and fail open, silently losing memory writes.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 95-100, 143-148, 258-264 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed and the generated configuration hard-codes `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`.
  WHY: Existing callers exit with `unknown argument`, while bypassing the option would route Codex around the loopback broker.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: Line 52-57 (codex_config_assemble removed --provider-base-url case) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `codex_config_assemble` no longer accepts or forwards `--provider-base-url`.
  WHY: Remaining callers fail before configuration is written and cannot use the broker-routed endpoint.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage line 7, option parsing lines 49-65, and process-group handling | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` and process-group metadata, identity verification, survivor checks, and cleanup were removed while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes the option.
  WHY: Isolated editor launches exit with `unknown option`, and isolated descendants are no longer tracked or safely reaped.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 494-509 and 952-1356 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` and the review_blocked_* helper family were deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` and `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` still invoke them.
  WHY: Authenticated judge pushes, approval handling, successor processing, and terminal review-blocked actions fail or are skipped.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 766-772, 833-843, 913-924 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: REST and GraphQL normalized PR comment payloads no longer emit `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Review-blocked producer and approver identity checks cannot match trusted comments, leaving approval requests pending or refusal envelopes invalid.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 98-237 (STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER block) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore logic depends on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but `.github/workflows/implement.yml` does not create or export them.
  WHY: The restore logic is dead, so self-repository runs can overwrite branch-owned helper edits with SCRIPT_REF copies.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 152-156 (constants removed), lines 536-716 (emit_context) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and the 256-path/output bounds were removed, and missing or overflow markers do not advance `used_bytes`.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can emit unbounded markers and exceed the documented context budget; the removed symbols also cause test import failures.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: lines 30, 37 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test imports `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were removed from `scripts/targeted_file_context.py`.
  WHY: Pytest collection fails with ImportError before targeted-context tests run.
- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py: lines 100-101, 118-121, 143, 275, 305, 339, 372-373 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The test still invokes removed review_blocked_* functions and asserts that `_memory_git` remains in `memory_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: Bash subprocesses fail with command-not-found and the authentication-wrapper assertions fail, breaking CI.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-81 versus later memory steps | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The workflow exports GIT_CONFIG_* authentication only in one step, while later memory operations run after checkout credential persistence is disabled.
  WHY: Step-scoped authentication does not reach later memory Git calls, so lineage finalization and ai-memory updates fail or silently no-op.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: lines 127-132 (python3 unavailable branch) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: When python3 is unavailable, the wrapper falls through to an unguarded `exec "$@"` instead of refusing isolated launches.
  WHY: Isolated editor execution loses stall supervision and process-group cleanup; severity is major.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: lines 3040-3047 (_inject_token_into_url) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: SSH and file URLs are returned unchanged without authentication.
  WHY: Memory clone operations using SSH or file origins cannot authenticate and fail open.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: _kill_child_group_if_running at 290-303 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Stall-guard cleanup only inspects the sudo wrapper and no longer identity-checks or waits for isolated descendants.
  WHY: Orphaned nobody-owned editor processes can continue holding workspace files after ownership restoration.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
